about: A verdict on every arrow of the riemann-blueprint, from the references of the published formal proof. Written by tools/lean-edges/verdicts.py; the README beside it says how to rebuild it. No Lean was built: the references are read from a published export of the proof, and cross-checked against the mirror's public build cache.

proof.note: The export holds the dependency closure of the five main theorems, so a declaration missing from it is not used by the proof.

cross_check.note: Every compiled module of the mirror at this commit, read from its build cache. A later tree than the export's: where the two disagree, the arrow is listed under differs with the cache's verdict.
